stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Why was the shutter up all night?

stations.title: Ticket printer
stations.text: Runs out of paper, and the program stops

stations.title: The hut at night
stations.text: Shutter down, printer off, till shut.

captions: The hut on a Tuesday. Bridie wants it closed up, whatever goes wrong while selling.
Today the paper runs out, the program stops, and the shutter stays up all night.
You clean up with finally and a try with resources, and let the failure go on.
Now a failure still stops the sale, and the hut is closed up behind it.
Closed up, every time. Next, the hut gets exceptions with names of its own.
